title: Handwritten notes with right-triangle trigonometry sketch; questions on auroral sightings
description: Blue-ink notes headed "Ques to ask White/McD." listing "Log book material sketches of auroral", "on board tape times of auroral sightings" and "Films (16 mm)". At right is a hand-drawn right triangle with sides labeled a, b, c and angle θ, accompanied by trigonometric relations such as "sin²θ + cos²θ = 1" and "cos θ = b/c".
